nodes.label: Design tokens (purple scale, amber, coral, green)
nodes.norm_label: design tokens (purple scale, amber, coral, green)
nodes.rationale: 60/30/8/2 color ratio with brand #5B4FD1 as page floor; contrast values precomputed for WCAG AA.

nodes.label: Typography (Nunito, clamp scale)
nodes.rationale: Nunito is round with full Vietnamese diacritics; heading line-height >= 1.18 to avoid clipped marks.

nodes.label: Cozy Purple theme (current UI)
nodes.rationale: cozy.css loads after style.css; removing its link tag reverts to old UI.

nodes.label: Chunky hard-edge button/card style
nodes.rationale: Hierarchy via color blocks and 4px thick bottom edge instead of 1px borders; pressed state sinks 3px.

nodes.label: Progress Tracking feature
nodes.rationale: Comparison only across same scale fingerprint; no thresholds or diagnoses; consent versioned with SHA-256.

nodes.label: Response quality scoring (services/quality.js)
nodes.rationale: Spam requires 2+ signals and score under 45 so a single factor never concludes spam.

nodes.label: Admin area
nodes.rationale: is_admin only changed directly in database; all /api/admin/* require requireAuth and requireAdmin.

nodes.label: brainst0rm Survey Platform
nodes.rationale: Lightweight SaaS for psychology/behavior surveys prioritizing real data, clear access control and never losing responses when questions are edited.

nodes.label: Dataset versioning (migration 005)
nodes.rationale: Stores only metadata and HMAC checksum, no copy or restore of answers.

nodes.label: CSV/XLSX export and PDF report
nodes.rationale: Excludes confirmed-invalid responses by default, no free text in PDF to reduce sensitive data exposure.

nodes.label: Progress Tracking (migration 006)
nodes.rationale: Default OFF so surveys without config behave as before; credentials stored only as HMAC; researchers never see profile identity; no good/bad interpretation of scores.

nodes.label: Researcher review and quality checks
nodes.rationale: Auto flags are screening signals only and never auto-exclude a response.
